comment: 55yo male, 25 years stainless-steel welder (shielded-metal-arc welding on austenitic stainless — hexavalent chromium fume + nickel co-exposure), never-smoker. No current lung or sinonasal cancer. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = risk-adjusted annual LDCT chest (Cr(VI)-modified USPSTF criteria) + annual ENT consultation with symptom review (unilateral nasal obstruction, epistaxis, anosmia, persistent rhinorrhea) + low-threshold nasal endoscopy / CT sinus on symptom develop + smoking-cessation counseling reinforcement; alternative = routine USPSTF screening only. Validates v0.3 occupational batch-3 pilot — fires RF-OCC-HEXAVALENT-CHROMIUM-PREVENTION.
